facts.fact: 外婆的爆料：幸好 Max 只顾冰球才离婚回国——Bailey 因此住进 Ted 家
facts.anchor: she was glad Max focused so much on hockey, because it meant they broke up

facts.fact: 猫的下场：父母嫌她抱着猫坐篮子不像「正常十岁儿童」，把猫送走
facts.anchor: They even got rid of my cat.

facts.fact: Ted 的「男孩教育」：叫他女孩子、当众嘲笑、羽毛球对头射
facts.anchor: Ted aimed shuttlecocks at my head.

facts.fact: 「他是我亲爸，我应该爱他」——她还留着他的姓 Jackson
facts.anchor: I even have his last name still: Jackson.

facts.fact: Flora 的法条：不值得的人不必爱，就算是家人
facts.anchor: You don’t have to love people who don’t deserve it. Even if they’re family.

facts.fact: Bailey 拜托她饭后跟 Max 谈监护权——自己开口怕他生气
facts.anchor: Will you talk to him for me, after dinner, about the custody thing?

facts.fact: 菠萝披萨整蛊：Max 强装无所谓却当场垮脸
facts.anchor: ordered you a pineapple pizza with extra pineapple.

facts.fact: 章末立誓：Bailey 和 Max 值得重新相爱
